Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2023: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Interest Income; Net Interest Income Total; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Fuel Trees; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Timber Trees; Gains/(Losses) From Changes In Fair Value Of Biological Assets - Unharvested Green Leaf) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged. Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit does not hold in FY2025 because the statement carries items below profit before tax (Loss From Discontinued Operations); the figures are as filed.
